answer: Forge-bridge slot burn bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and burns a deposit for one forge slot on the bridge. Each epoch the slot issues a plume ticket; the holder returns fresh signed forge work with that plume receipt, or a bridge auditor burns the bond. Deposits rise 25 plus 10 per extra identity; 1,000 fakes cost 5,090,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-slot ring fails, and an honest forge pays 95 once.
